columns.name: f53
samples: Plant healing seeds upon your allies and nurture their growth! As a Naturalist, you'll rejuvenate your party with a range of healing-over-time effects, caring for them until it’s time for them to bloom, resulting in massive bursts of healing. Maintain and manage your seedlings to keep your party moving forward!

Mend your allies in the light of dawn. As a Dawnkeeper, you'll designate one party member to serve as a Beacon of Light. When you heal your Beacon with Holy Light, the power swells and bursts, healing nearby allies. Support your Beacon and light the way through the darkness!

Bold and dedicated clerics, Eternal Caretakers stand beside their allies in the heat of combat. Staunch and unflinching, their powerful Halo skill emits a wave of healing energy that sweeps out over nearby allies. Casting other healing spells reduces Halo's cooldown.

Manipulators of Holy Light, Sacred Sentinels conjure powerful healing spells that can heal the very land itself. Create spheres of Holy radiance that periodically heal allies beneath their rays, eventually bursting for an immense heal. Allies blessed by this prayer become veiled in light, empowering your healing spells.

Wield the tides to heal your allies, manipulating their waves to spread among your party and keep them topped off. With Healing Wave, you can spread your Riptide to an injured party member, eventually cascading across your entire party.
